title: Flipper Busy Bar Review: An Expensive Focus Tool Worth It?
excerpt: The Flipper Busy Bar is an expensive productivity gadget that promises to protect your focus. Our review finds it doesn't stop interruptions but does help concentration through self-signaling. Here's our verdict for tech professionals.
description: Flipper Busy Bar review: This expensive focus tool aids concentration through self-signaling but doesn't stop interruptions. Is it worth it for tech professionals?
